title: Lack of `instantRedeemWithPxEth` support
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Pirex ETH's redemption process using upxETH (via `initiateRedemption` and `redeemWithUpxEth`) requires some time and depends on multiple factors:  - The number of users wanting to withdraw: if `pendingWithdrawal` has not reached `DEPOSIT_SIZE`, need to wait more users need to withdraw until `pendingWithdrawal` reaches `DEPOSIT_SIZE`. - To withdraw the full balance of a validator, it must first exit entirely.
